protocol.scope: paired diagnostic of point-only coordinate change; not HOTA
protocol.selection: existing default video of run_bdd_video_rate_experiment; all labelled intervals
invariants: identical saved decoded vectors and gain
protocol.gate: Any nonfinite output or increased mean endpoint error blocks a claim of non-regression. Even a passed one-video check cannot establish tracking benefit or general safety.
protocol.corrections: No fitting, data filtering, gain tuning or scientific model training permitted.

limitations: Retrospective one-video point replay; does not rerun renderer or neural core; no HOTA, no claim of general quality improvement.
